verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a RESTful API for processing applicant data and controlling the verification flow, plus an official MCP server that lets AI agents perform Sumsub operations with access scoped by existing role permissions. Webhooks, WebSDK permalinks and access tokens cover outcome notification and session initiation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the individual operations (session creation, status polling, extracted-data retrieval, re-check triggers), evidence of scoped API keys beyond MCP role permissions, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
